generator_script.purpose: Generate an exhaustive exact API index from the official AppAuth 0.11.1 sources or Javadoc JAR available in the local Maven cache.
usage: Place appauth-0.11.1-javadoc.jar or appauth-0.11.1-sources.jar beside the script.
Replace/merge api_index entries with the generated exact signatures before enabling strict fixture allowlisting.
generator_script.python:
import json
import re
import zipfile
from pathlib import Path
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup

VERSION = "0.11.1"
JAVADOC_JAR = Path(f"appauth-{VERSION}-javadoc.jar")
SOURCE_JAR = Path(f"appauth-{VERSION}-sources.jar")
OUT = Path(f"appauth_{VERSION.replace('.', '_')}_full_api_index.json")

def normalize(text):
    return " ".join(text.split())

def from_javadoc(path):
    classes = []
    with zipfile.ZipFile(path) as zf:
        html_names = [
            n for n in zf.namelist()
            if n.startswith("net/openid/appauth/")
            and n.endswith(".html")
            and not n.endswith(("package-summary.html", "package-tree.html"))
        ]
        for name in html_names:
            soup = BeautifulSoup(zf.read(name), "html.parser")
            fqcn = name[:-5].replace("/", ".")
            item = {
                "class": fqcn,
                "constructors": [],
                "methods": [],
                "fields": [],
                "enum_constants": []
            }
            page_text = soup.get_text("\n")
            for heading, key in [
                ("Constructor Summary", "constructors"),
                ("Method Summary", "methods"),
                ("Field Summary", "fields"),
                ("Enum Constant Summary", "enum_constants")
            ]:
                node = soup.find(lambda tag: tag.name in ("h2", "h3")
                                 and heading.lower() in tag.get_text(" ", strip=True).lower())
                if node:
                    container = node.find_next(["section", "div", "table"])
                    if container:
                        vals = []
                        for code in container.select("code"):
                            value = normalize(code.get_text(" ", strip=True))
                            if value and value not in vals:
                                vals.append(value)
                        item[key] = vals
            classes.append(item)
    return classes

def from_sources(path):
    classes = []
    with zipfile.ZipFile(path) as zf:
        for name in zf.namelist():
            if not name.startswith("net/openid/appauth/") or not name.endswith(".java"):
                continue
            src = zf.read(name).decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
            fqcn = name[:-5].replace("/", ".")
            public_methods = []
            public_ctors = []
            public_fields = []
            for match in re.finditer(
                r"(?m)^\s*public\s+(?:static\s+|final\s+|synchronized\s+)*"
                r"(?:(?P<ret>[\w<>\[\].?, ]+)\s+)?"
                r"(?P<name>\w+)\s*\((?P<args>[^)]*)\)",
                src
            ):
                signature = normalize(match.group(0).strip().rstrip("{"))
                simple = fqcn.split(".")[-1]
                if match.group("name") == simple:
                    public_ctors.append(signature)
                else:
                    public_methods.append(signature)
            for match in re.finditer(
                r"(?m)^\s*public\s+(?:static\s+)?(?:final\s+)?[\w<>\[\].?, ]+\s+\w+\s*(?:=|;)",
                src
            ):
                public_fields.append(normalize(match.group(0).strip()))
            classes.append({
                "class": fqcn,
                "constructors": public_ctors,
                "methods": public_methods,
                "fields": public_fields
            })
    return classes

if JAVADOC_JAR.exists():
    classes = from_javadoc(JAVADOC_JAR)
    source = str(JAVADOC_JAR)
elif SOURCE_JAR.exists():
    classes = from_sources(SOURCE_JAR)
    source = str(SOURCE_JAR)
else:
    raise SystemExit("Provide the AppAuth 0.11.1 javadoc or sources JAR.")

payload = {
    "schema_version": "1.0",
    "library": "AppAuth for Android",
    "version": VERSION,
    "source": source,
    "maven_coordinates": [f"net.openid:appauth:{VERSION}"],
    "api_index": classes
}
OUT.write_text(json.dumps(payload, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
print(f"wrote {OUT} with {len(classes)} classes")
